sections.title: Consumer
sections.gist: Person who buys goods/hires services for consideration, not for resale or commercial purpose.

sections.title: Deficiency
sections.gist: Fault, imperfection, shortcoming in quality/nature/manner of performance of a service.

sections.title: Unfair trade practice
sections.gist: False representation, misleading advertisement or deceptive practice in sale of goods/services.

sections.title: Advertisement
sections.gist: Any audio/visual publicity, representation or notice promoting sale of goods or services.

sections.title: Consumer rights
sections.gist: Right to safety, information, choice, be heard, redressal and consumer education.

sections.title: Jurisdiction of District Commission
sections.gist: Pecuniary and territorial jurisdiction of the District Commission to entertain complaints.

sections.title: Manner of filing complaint
sections.gist: Complaint may be filed by consumer, recognised association, or Central/State Government.

sections.title: Procedure on receipt of complaint
sections.gist: Commission's procedure for admitting and processing complaints on receipt.

sections.title: Procedure on admission of complaint
sections.gist: Reference to mediation, notice to opposite party, evidence and hearing procedure.

sections.title: Reliefs
sections.gist: Orders the Commission may pass: removal of defect/deficiency, replacement, refund, compensation, costs.

sections.title: Review
sections.gist: District Commission may review its own order on application within 30 days or on its own motion.

sections.title: Appeal to State Commission
sections.gist: Appeal against District Commission order lies to State Commission within 45 days.

sections.title: Limitation period
sections.gist: Complaint must be filed within 2 years from the date on which the cause of action arose.

sections.title: Enforcement of orders
sections.gist: Orders of the Commission are enforced as if a decree of a civil court.

sections.title: Penalty for non-compliance
sections.gist: Imprisonment (1 month to 3 years) and/or fine (Rs 25,000 to Rs 1 lakh) for failure to comply with an order.
